item.title: First, make me care
item.description:
📝 Writing advice: some nonfiction fails because it opens with background instead of a hook—readers leave before reaching the good material. Find the single anomaly or question that makes your topic interesting, lead with that, and let the background follow once you’ve earned attention. [Return to blog index].

Spanish track was fractured before high-speed train disaster, report finds
item.description:
📝 Spanish track was fractured before high-speed train disaster, report finds2 days agoShareSaveHafsa KhalilShareSaveSpain's CIAFGrooves were found on wheels of the Iryo train that had already passed over the track before the derailmentA fracture in a straight section of track "occurred prior to the passage" of a high-speed train that derailed, causing last Sunday's rail disaster in which 45 people died, an initial report has found. The CIAF rail investigation commission said not only did Iryo train's front carriages which stayed on the track have "notches" in their wheels, but three earlier trains that went over the track earlier did too. The train's last three carriages - carriages six to eight - derailed and collided with the Huelva-bound Renfe train.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1m77dmxlvlo

item.title: Data Leak Exposes 149M Logins, Including Gmail, Facebook
FAA institutes nationwide drone no-fly zones around ICE operations
item.description:
📝 FAA institutes nationwide drone no-fly zones around ICE operationsByStephen PopeJanuary 22, 2026, 22:41 (UTC +3) 1 comment Drones DJI The Federal Aviation Administration has issued a nationwide security notice, effectively creating a moving drone no-fly zone around operations conducted by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and other components of the Department of Homeland Security. Because ICE operates under DHS and routinely conducts enforcement actions using mobile vehicle convoys in public spaces, the restriction functions as a drone no-fly zone around ICE operations, including arrests, transport activities and other field actions. The new NOTAM replaces an earlier security notice, FDC 5/6378, which covered similar federal agencies but was less explicit about mobile operations.
🔗 Read more: https://www.aerotime.aero/articles/faa-drone-no-fly-zone-ice-dhs
